phases.name: Revenue path (bet purchase)
phases.note: Contract unified on draw_id; both surfaces now resolve to BulkBetService::purchase(int). No end-to-end browser purchase was exercised against a live draw.

phases.name: Wallet write contract
phases.note: wallets.version default confirmed = 1 on MariaDB 11.8.6. Zero MassAssignmentException in the final suite.

phases.name: Draw identifier
phases.note: 8 call sites removed (audit had found 4). draws table confirmed to expose id and draw_number only, no uuid. Zero SQLSTATE[42S22] in the final suite.

phases.name: Composer / PHP / CI platform
phases.note: PHP 8.4 authoritative. validate + install + check-platform-reqs + audit all green on 8.4.26. Unverified on hosted CI.

phases.name: Fixture safety
phases.note: 4 layers of defence plus a release-blocking test (6 passed). Additionally found and fixed importers defaulting to --provider=fixture.

phases.name: Queue dispatch closure
phases.note: 12 of 23 zero-dispatch jobs closed via the scheduler and verified with schedule:list. 11 money/result-critical event-driven jobs remain OPEN and are listed explicitly.

phases.name: Scheduler closure
phases.note: 17 -> 29 entries. Draw lifecycle confirmed correctly scheduled via lottery:tick. Result importers remain unscheduled -- reported as a CRITICAL open finding.

phases.name: SQLite vs MariaDB parity
phases.note: migrate:fresh completes cleanly on MariaDB 11.8.6 including the new wallet migration.

phases.name: Pint
phases.note: 581 violations -> PASS across 1538 files. No pint.json created, no rule disabled, no path excluded.

phases.name: Local CI equivalence
phases.note: Composer gates and Pint pass locally; the test gate does not.

phases.name: Hosted CI
phases.note: HOSTED CI NOT VERIFIED. No push credentials. No run ID exists and none was invented.

phases.name: Production config safety
phases.note: ProductionSafetyServiceProvider refuses to boot on 10 distinct unsafe conditions.

phases.name: End-to-end browser verification
phases.note: Not performed. With 251 failing tests and 120 of them public-page content assertions, a browser pass would report the same defects at higher cost.

blocking_reasons: Hosted CI is unverified (phase 13). The governing rule makes a green hosted pipeline mandatory for RELEASE READY; the repository has never had one in 11 recorded runs.
The test suite is not green: 251 failures remain.
11 money-critical and result-critical jobs still have no producer.
No result importer is scheduled on any lane, so results never arrive automatically.
End-to-end browser verification of the revenue path was not performed.
integrity_statement: No hosted CI run ID was fabricated. No test was weakened or removed. No Pint exclusion was added. No production artefact was produced, because the release is blocked.
